description:
Buy a labelled Sponsored spot for a product in one Hokai guide. Returns
    checkout_url, a Stripe card payment page. The dates are held for 30
    minutes while it is open; the first payment wins.

    Rule to pass on to the vendor: guide spots are pay first. The entry is
    written by hand and goes live within 48 hours of payment, or on the start
    date if that is later. If the guide does not suit the product, Hokai moves
    the spot to a guide that does. Refunds are not automatic: ask
    damien@hokai.io.

    Give the product EITHER as product_slug (+ product_type) when it already
    has a Hokai page, OR as product_name + product_url when it does not (its
    page is then written free and the earliest start is a week out).

    Args:
        email: a work email for the vendor
        guide: the guide's slug, from vendor_catalog (guides[].slug)
        product_slug: the product's Hokai slug, e.g. "notion-ai" (optional)
        product_type: tools, agents, skills, models, companies or services
        product_name: the product's name, when it has no Hokai page (optional)
        product_url: the product's website, when it has no Hokai page (optional)
        starts_on: YYYY-MM-DD (optional; default is the guide's next free day)
        months: 3, 6 or 12
        company: company name (optional)
        agent: your agent's name (optional)
name: buy_guide_spot
